decisions.reason: As a visible home-page product line close to the firm’s core handcrafted offer, it has both investment and public commitment behind it, which makes management likely to continue it.

Because it fits the established Christmas pyramid business and was promoted prominently, management can justify keeping it as a natural extension rather than admitting a mistake after only a short time.
Although it is distant from the traditional range, it was launched as a flagship line and highlighted on the home page, so escalation of commitment strongly favors persistence.

This accessory is less publicly committed than the main products, but because it supports the flagship electronic music box platform, management is still more likely to retain it than withdraw it quickly.
